divergences: Wallpaper (purple/blue/orange abstract macOS art) approximated with layered CSS radial/linear gradients rather than the exact photographic source; the diagonal metallic streak faintly visible through the window's backdrop-filter blur (bottom-right of detail pane) is a coarser CSS approximation than the photographic original.

Remaining RMSE is dominated by photographic wallpaper texture/JPEG compression grain outside and faintly through the vibrancy-blurred window, plus font antialiasing differences — not content or layout mismatches.

extraCanonicalHiddenDom: .search .ph[data-demo-key="query"] (hidden data-demo-only span that receives the typed query text; canonical frame only shows the placeholder span)
demo.notes: List and input exploration controls are wired (arrow keys / hover / typing re-filter via data-demo-match), but the detail pane (title/subtitle/Bounds row) only patches for the two scripted rows (uad, cmux) via the cmuxDetail/uadDetail states — hovering or arrow-selecting any other row during free exploration moves the list selection/hover highlight but does not update the detail pane, since patch content for the other 7 rows was out of scope for this pass.
